newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bridgestone buys in Singapore rubber, INRO watched.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone buys in Singapore rubber, INRO watched.

text.p: Bridgestone was said to have bought several hundred tonnes of TSR20 rubber on Thursday and is said to be bidding for more, dealers said.
Goodyear is also said to be interested in buying SIR10 rubber although there has been no report of any deal concluded so far, they said.
"Bridgestone bought some nearby TSR20 rubber and I heard they were bidding for more," a trader said. "Goodyear though is looking for some SIR10 rubber."
Another dealer said European and local manufacturers were engaged in shortcovering for RSS3 and TSR20 rubber.
The buying was being done ahead of any possible intervention by the International Natural Rubber Organisation (INRO) in the market, traders said.
"We saw some fairly modest shortcovering. People are waiting for INRO's move. This prompted some people to buy before they (INRO) get in," a dealer said.

At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 91.50 U.S. cents a kg from 92.00 cents. October RSS1 was seen at 140.00 Singapore cents (98 U.S. cents) a kg from 140.75 cents. October TSR20 was seen at 98.75 U.S. cents a kg from 99.00 cents.
